draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.77, the 3rd-best grade among 257 2026 draftees and 1st of 27 at CB. He went 6th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Quinyon Mitchell. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (83rd percentile). College production: his final season (2025) ranked 3rd in passes defended among the 27 CBs in his class with stats.
